report.incidentSummary: On the morning of 2026-10-14, users reported that mutual fund portfolio values and P&L were unchanged from the previous day, while stock prices remained accurate. The investigation revealed that the nightly nav-import job in market-data-service aborted at 23:32 IST on 2026-10-13 due to an unhandled 'N.A.' value for scheme code 118191 in the AMFI NAV file. As a result, 0 of 14,231 NAVs were written, leaving stale NAVs from 2026-10-12 active. Portfolio-service fell back to displaying these last-known NAVs, leading to stale mutual fund portfolio valuations.
report.rootCauseStatement: market-data-service aborted its nightly AMFI NAV file ingestion after encountering an unhandled 'N.A.' string for scheme code 118191 at line 8982 of NAVAll.txt, writing 0 of 14,231 NAVs and leaving stale 2026-10-12 NAVs active with no automated retry.

hypotheses.cause: market-data-service aborted its nightly AMFI NAV ingestion after encountering an unhandled 'N.A.' string for scheme code 118191, writing 0 of 14,231 NAVs and leaving stale 2026-10-12 NAVs active with no automated retry.
hypotheses.rationale: Direct log evidence confirms that the nav-import job failed at 2026-10-13T18:02:00Z with a parse error on 'N.A.', writing 0 NAV records. Metrics show nav_age_s rising past 34 hours while portfolio-service logged warnings about stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 starting well before morning market open.

hypotheses.cause: portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 (version 7.3.0) refactored valuation code and caused mutual fund valuations to fail or calculate yesterday's values.
hypotheses.rationale: Although CHG-48221 deployed at 03:40:00 UTC (09:10 IST), coinciding with user complaints, portfolio-service was already logging warnings about stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 from 02:16 UTC, and the underlying NAV age had been rising since 18:00 UTC on 2026-10-13. The valuation refactor did not introduce errors or cause the stale data.

facts.statement: The scheduled nightly nav-import job (run_7fadae4b) was triggered by job-scheduler at 2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z (23:30 IST) and failed with an error, reflected in job-scheduler jobs_failed metric spiking to 0.0667/min.

market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00.000Z, but encountered a parse error at line 8982: 'invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191', aborting the job with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written.
market-data-service nav_age_s increased continuously from 86,340 seconds (~24 hours) at 18:00:00.000Z on 2026-10-13 to 125,460 seconds (~34.85 hours) by 04:55:00.000Z on 2026-10-14.

portfolio-service repeatedly logged warnings starting at 2026-10-14T02:16:24.606Z that fund NAVs were older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and fell back to displaying the last available NAV.
portfolio-service price_age_s was normal throughout the investigation window (mean 2.01s), and cache hit rates for the nav keyspace remained healthy (~94.5%).
portfolio-service was deployed at 2026-10-14T03:40:00.000Z under CHG-48221 (version 7.2.0 to 7.3.0), while no changes occurred on market-data-service, job-scheduler, or cache.

inferences.statement: The stale mutual fund portfolio valuations were caused by market-data-service serving outdated NAVs dated 2026-10-12 following the aborted ingestion, rather than cache failures or stock price feed errors.
The onset of customer complaints at 09:10 IST was coincidental with the deployment of CHG-48221, driven instead by retail users opening the app as Indian markets opened.

assumptions.statement: AMFI NAVAll.txt legitimately published 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191 on this date (e.g. for a suspended or newly introduced scheme), which the parser was not designed to handle gracefully.

timeline.event: Nightly nav-import job run_7fadae4b triggered by job-scheduler.
market-data-service successfully downloads NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed.
nav-import encounters unhandled parse error: invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191 at line 8982.
market-data-service aborts import with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, leaving 2026-10-12 NAV dataset active.
job-scheduler registers nav-import job failure; no retry is triggered.
portfolio-service begins logging warnings that fund NAVs are older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and falls back to showing last available NAV.
portfolio-service version 7.3.0 deployed (CHG-48221); retail user activity surges at market open, triggering complaints of stale mutual fund valuations.
Customer support logs incident INC-2249.

confidence.rationale: Direct log and metric evidence definitively proves that nav-import aborted due to the unhandled 'N.A.' string on scheme 118191, explaining why only mutual fund valuations were stale while stocks functioned normally.

recommendedActions.action: Manually re-run the NAV import job for the 2026-10-13/2026-10-14 AMFI dataset after sanitizing or skipping line 8982.
recommendedActions.rationale: Immediately populates current mutual fund NAVs into market-data-service, restoring accurate portfolio valuations.
recommendedActions.verification: Check market-data-service nav_age_s drops to near 0 and portfolio-service warnings for nav_date=2026-10-12 cease.

recommendedActions.action: Update the AMFI NAV parser in market-data-service to handle 'N.A.' or non-numeric NAV strings gracefully (e.g., skip the line with a warning or retain the previous day's NAV for that individual scheme without failing the batch).
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents a single unlisted or corrupt scheme from aborting ingestion of all 14,000+ mutual fund NAVs.
recommendedActions.verification: Deploy parser update and run a test parse against NAVAll.txt containing 'N.A.' entries.

recommendedActions.action: Configure alerting and automated retries in job-scheduler and market-data-service for failed nav-import executions.
recommendedActions.rationale: The failure at 18:02 UTC went undetected and unretried until users noticed stale values the next morning.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify on-call pager triggers when nav-import fails, and check that job-scheduler initiates configured retries.

payload.markdown:
# Investigation report: Portfolio shows yesterday's values

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On the morning of 2026-10-14, users reported that mutual fund portfolio values and P&L were unchanged from the previous day, while stock prices remained accurate. The investigation revealed that the nightly nav-import job in market-data-service aborted at 23:32 IST on 2026-10-13 due to an unhandled 'N.A.' value for scheme code 118191 in the AMFI NAV file. As a result, 0 of 14,231 NAVs were written, leaving stale NAVs from 2026-10-12 active. Portfolio-service fell back to displaying these last-known NAVs, leading to stale mutual fund portfolio valuations.

**Root cause:** market-data-service aborted its nightly AMFI NAV file ingestion after encountering an unhandled 'N.A.' string for scheme code 118191 at line 8982 of NAVAll.txt, writing 0 of 14,231 NAVs and leaving stale 2026-10-12 NAVs active with no automated retry.

## Hypotheses
1. **market-data-service aborted its nightly AMFI NAV ingestion after encountering an unhandled 'N.A.' string for scheme code 118191, writing 0 of 14,231 NAVs and leaving stale 2026-10-12 NAVs active with no automated retry.** — `market-data-service`, data_pipeline_failure, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_5, ev_7, ev_11, ev_12, ev_13, ev_14, ev_16] · Contradicting: none
   - Direct log evidence confirms that the nav-import job failed at 2026-10-13T18:02:00Z with a parse error on 'N.A.', writing 0 NAV records. Metrics show nav_age_s rising past 34 hours while portfolio-service logged warnings about stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 starting well before morning market open.
2. **portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 (version 7.3.0) refactored valuation code and caused mutual fund valuations to fail or calculate yesterday's values.** — `portfolio-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_1] · Contradicting: [ev_6, ev_7, ev_11, ev_12, ev_13]
   - Although CHG-48221 deployed at 03:40:00 UTC (09:10 IST), coinciding with user complaints, portfolio-service was already logging warnings about stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 from 02:16 UTC, and the underlying NAV age had been rising since 18:00 UTC on 2026-10-13. The valuation refactor did not introduce errors or cause the stale data.

## Facts
- The scheduled nightly nav-import job (run_7fadae4b) was triggered by job-scheduler at 2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z (23:30 IST) and failed with an error, reflected in job-scheduler jobs_failed metric spiking to 0.0667/min. [ev_11, ev_14]
- market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00.000Z, but encountered a parse error at line 8982: 'invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191', aborting the job with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written. [ev_5, ev_11]
- market-data-service nav_age_s increased continuously from 86,340 seconds (~24 hours) at 18:00:00.000Z on 2026-10-13 to 125,460 seconds (~34.85 hours) by 04:55:00.000Z on 2026-10-14. [ev_7, ev_13]
- portfolio-service repeatedly logged warnings starting at 2026-10-14T02:16:24.606Z that fund NAVs were older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and fell back to displaying the last available NAV. [ev_12]
- portfolio-service price_age_s was normal throughout the investigation window (mean 2.01s), and cache hit rates for the nav keyspace remained healthy (~94.5%). [ev_6, ev_9]
- portfolio-service was deployed at 2026-10-14T03:40:00.000Z under CHG-48221 (version 7.2.0 to 7.3.0), while no changes occurred on market-data-service, job-scheduler, or cache. [ev_1, ev_15]

## Inferences
- The stale mutual fund portfolio valuations were caused by market-data-service serving outdated NAVs dated 2026-10-12 following the aborted ingestion, rather than cache failures or stock price feed errors. [ev_6, ev_7, ev_9, ev_11, ev_12, ev_16]
- The onset of customer complaints at 09:10 IST was coincidental with the deployment of CHG-48221, driven instead by retail users opening the app as Indian markets opened. [ev_1, ev_12, ev_13]

## Assumptions
- AMFI NAVAll.txt legitimately published 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191 on this date (e.g. for a suspended or newly introduced scheme), which the parser was not designed to handle gracefully.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z (23:30 IST)** Nightly nav-import job run_7fadae4b triggered by job-scheduler. [ev_11]
- **2026-10-13T18:01:00.000Z (23:31 IST)** market-data-service successfully downloads NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed. [ev_11]
- **2026-10-13T18:02:00.000Z (23:32 IST)** nav-import encounters unhandled parse error: invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191 at line 8982. [ev_11]
- **2026-10-13T18:02:06.000Z (23:32 IST)** market-data-service aborts import with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, leaving 2026-10-12 NAV dataset active. [ev_11]
- **2026-10-13T18:06:00.000Z (23:36 IST)** job-scheduler registers nav-import job failure; no retry is triggered. [ev_11, ev_14]
- **2026-10-14T02:16:24.606Z (07:46 IST)** portfolio-service begins logging warnings that fund NAVs are older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and falls back to showing last available NAV. [ev_12]
- **2026-10-14T03:40:00.000Z (09:10 IST)** portfolio-service version 7.3.0 deployed (CHG-48221); retail user activity surges at market open, triggering complaints of stale mutual fund valuations. [ev_1, ev_12]
- **2026-10-14T04:10:00.000Z (09:40 IST)** Customer support logs incident INC-2249. [ev_1]

## Confidence
0.95: Direct log and metric evidence definitively proves that nav-import aborted due to the unhandled 'N.A.' string on scheme 118191, explaining why only mutual fund valuations were stale while stocks functioned normally.

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Manually re-run the NAV import job for the 2026-10-13/2026-10-14 AMFI dataset after sanitizing or skipping line 8982. [ev_7, ev_11, ev_12]
  - Why: Immediately populates current mutual fund NAVs into market-data-service, restoring accurate portfolio valuations.
  - Verify: Check market-data-service nav_age_s drops to near 0 and portfolio-service warnings for nav_date=2026-10-12 cease.
- **[next]** Update the AMFI NAV parser in market-data-service to handle 'N.A.' or non-numeric NAV strings gracefully (e.g., skip the line with a warning or retain the previous day's NAV for that individual scheme without failing the batch). [ev_11]
  - Why: Prevents a single unlisted or corrupt scheme from aborting ingestion of all 14,000+ mutual fund NAVs.
  - Verify: Deploy parser update and run a test parse against NAVAll.txt containing 'N.A.' entries.
- **[next]** Configure alerting and automated retries in job-scheduler and market-data-service for failed nav-import executions. [ev_11, ev_14]
  - Why: The failure at 18:02 UTC went undetected and unretried until users noticed stale values the next morning.
  - Verify: Verify on-call pager triggers when nav-import fails, and check that job-scheduler initiates configured retries.
